name: Faking It with the Hockey Captain
original_name: Faking It with the Hockey Captain
overview: Scholarship girl Julie has one reckless, electric night with the irresistibly hot new hockey captain—only to discover he's Liam, the childhood enemy she can't stand. To kill rumors and keep their exes away, they fake-date... But the chemistry feels anything but fake, and the tension between them is getting dangerously hard to resist.
